name: rollcall_vdog
about: Roll call: classname npc_VDog builds CNPC_VDog (factory 0x10373480, research/tooling/ghidra/driver/kernel_factories.tsv). One row taken verbatim from hw_warrens_1 (plus_crowd) stands in the arena; NPCThink 0x10292de0 -> RunAI 0x1026f110 -> MaintainSchedule: on its first thinks the class's SelectSchedule (its own override or the Troika arm it inherits) picks a program and SetSchedule 0x10280e50 installs it; the program then runs (StartTask/RunTask) for the rest of the ten seconds without a task failing every think.
known_red: 5: the StartHidden row thinks while hidden (cond+ FLOATING_OFF_GROUND and schedule FALL_TO_GROUND (0x3e) at t=0.00, before the 0.5 s ScriptUnhide; retail PostSpawn 0x100aaf30 -> ScriptHide 0x100a8710 parks the think at FLT_MAX). Was N10 ('installs no schedule'): that was red 6 -- the row is use_interesting 1 and the port's ambient executor held it; V3b deleted the executor and the row now selects
notes: Every standable row of npc_VDog is StartHidden; the record unhides it at 0.5 s, as its map's wire does. V3b (2026-10-04), a record error corrected: the two nevers before 0.45 s that V2 gave the other hidden roll-call rows were missing here -- retail's CBaseEntity::PostSpawn 0x100aaf30 runs slot 77 ScriptHide 0x100a8710 for m_bStartHidden, so a hidden row senses and selects nothing until ScriptUnhide 0x100a8990; without them the record passed on the hidden think red 5 names.
